announcements.headline: Cancellation - Gresham House Renewable Energy VCT2
announcements.insight: Following the September meeting results, this cancellation confirms the termination of the proposed scheme. Shareholders should expect a return of capital rather than participation in any restructured entity.

announcements.headline: Results of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The General Meeting results follow the August adjournment. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for further corporate actions.

announcements.headline: Dividend Delay and Adjournment of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The dividend declared in July is delayed, and the general meeting notice from August has been adjourned. Shareholders should watch for a new meeting date.

announcements.headline: Circular Publication and Notice of General Meeting
announcements.insight: A general meeting is convened following the July dividend declaration. Shareholders should watch for voting outcomes regarding this distribution.

announcements.headline: Dividend Declaration
announcements.insight: Gresham House Renewable Energy VCT 2 declares a dividend. This provides income to shareholders but offers limited insight into future performance or capital returns.
